findings.message: missing() resolves the project as `git rev-parse --show-toplevel`, but the mod (branch guard and propose gate) and MOD.md use the session's working directory. When `.specclaw/` lives in a subfolder of a larger repository, the guard finds no `<toplevel>/.specclaw/config.yaml` and exits 0 with no message. A guard that never looked then reads the same as 'nothing missing'. Fix: look for `.specclaw/config.yaml` in `$PWD` (the hook's cwd) first and fall back to the toplevel only when it is absent there. Add a test row for a project nested in a monorepo.
findings.scenario: Monorepo /mono, with the session cwd /mono/app and /mono/app/.specclaw/changes/002-x all done with no verify → done-guard checks /mono/.specclaw/config.yaml, which is absent, and exits 0 silently. Expected: exit 2 with '002-x has every task done, but no verify verdict'.

findings.message:
The two git.base_branch readers still disagree on CRLF configs. In GIT_BLOCK, a blank line inside the block must match `[ 	]*
`, so a `
` blank line ends the `git:` block. awk in lib/base-ref.sh treats `` as [[:space:]] and keeps the block open. The shared fixture has no CRLF row, so the parity test cannot catch this. Fix: normalise `
` to `
` before matching (and `tr -d ''` in base_config_branch), or allow `[ 	]*` in the blank-line alternative. Add a CRLF row to tests/fixtures/base-branch.tsv.
findings.scenario:
config.yaml saved with CRLF: 'git:

  base_branch: develop
' → base_config_branch (size cap, done guard) returns 'develop', while baseBranchFrom (branch guard) returns '' and falls back to origin/HEAD or main. On branch develop, edits are not held; on main, edits are held, even though main is not the configured base.

findings.message: The test-layout exclusions still list only the named spellings, so common variants of the same class count as production lines. Django `app/tests.py`, pytest `conftest.py`, `*_tests.*` (the plural of the covered `*_test.*`) and top-level `e2e/` and `cypress/` suites all count. Extend SIZE_EXCLUDE to cover these (for example '**/tests.*', '**/conftest.py', '**/*_tests.*', '**/e2e/**', '**/cypress/**') and add rows to the table test.
findings.scenario: size_cap 100 with untracked app/tests.py (90 lines) and src/views.py (20 lines) → 'size cap: 110 production lines is over the 100-line cap', exit 1 (verify FAIL). Expected: 20 lines, exit 0.

findings.message: `late` captures `git rev-list ... 2>&1`. If git exits 0 but writes a warning to stderr (for example a config or replace-ref warning), `late` is non-empty and the guard reports 'code was committed after its verify (warning: …)'. Capture stderr separately, so that only stdout decides whether a commit is newer than the verify.

The docs say 'The exact exclusion list is `SIZE_EXCLUDE` in `bin/specclaw-verify`', and templates/config.yaml says the same. The case-sensitive CamelCase patterns live in a second array, SIZE_EXCLUDE_CASED. Name both arrays in verify.md and in templates/config.yaml.
